notes:
MusicDev 0.8.5 brings the new cover workflow to Studio and Library.

- Create a square song cover with the title, artist and other selected words designed into the image. Use the song as inspiration, give your own direction, or ask for a revision to an existing cover.
- From Library, choose Publish on a recording to create artwork for a widescreen YouTube video, a separate thumbnail or a vertical Short.
- Cover requests keep their connection to the right song. A stalled background window can yield to the next request while preserving its submission record.

On Windows, open **Library → Settings → Check for updates**, then choose **Update and restart**. In Danish, choose **Bibliotek → Indstillinger → Søg efter opdateringer**.
